_comment: Bills a vendor sent us, and what our own meter says actually happened.
This is the whole of what a new customer has to hand over to be operated
for: an export of what they are billed and what they use. No keys, no
treasury access, no custody — a business with no `policy_wallet` is a
first-class case, and the registry calls it 'what an evaluation looks like'.
`used_quantity` ABSENT means we could not check, which is never the same as
zero: zero would assert the entitlement went unused and make every bill look
fraudulent. The agent escalates instead of accusing.
The period comes from the BILL. A window taken from the clock mints a new id
every run, so the same charge gets paid again and again.
Run: uv run python scripts/operator_run.py --business acme --entitlements docs/samples/entitlements.example.json

bills.note: Fifty seats billed, twelve opened. The agoranomos case.
Used almost exactly what was billed — inside the meter's tolerance.
No usage export from this vendor at all: `used_quantity` is absent, so the agent asks rather than accuses.
